principles.name: Proximity Threshold Connection
principles.sketch: Draw line when you get close
principles.core_mechanic: Instead of physics-based attraction, use pure distance threshold to spawn connections between particles.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: No persistent graph structure - connections exist only in the moment of proximity, creating ephemeral network visualizations.
principles.the_twist: Lines only exist between points that happen to be close - no memory, no history, just momentary adjacency.
variations: Variable threshold based on particle size

principles.name: Modulo Spawn Phase Shift
principles.core_mechanic: Particles spawn in polar coordinates with modulo timing, creating rhythmic birth cycles.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Uses modulo arithmetic on frame number to create deterministic spawn waves instead of random or continuous spawning.
principles.the_twist: Dual-phase spawning where even/odd particles use different hue offsets creating interleaved color waves.

principles.name: Bidirectional Orbital Trails
principles.core_mechanic: Particles move in opposite directions on concentric rings.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Instead of all particles rotating the same direction, alternating rings (or random assignment) create counter-rotation.
principles.the_twist: Trails are drawn as overlapping circles, not lines - creating fat motion blur artifacts.

principles.name: Noise Masked Geometry
principles.core_mechanic: Use 3D noise to selectively render faces of geometry.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Instead of culling by normal or frustum, Perlin noise decides which faces exist - creating organic erosion effects.
principles.the_twist: Inset triangles (scaled 0.6x toward centroid) create cut-out effect without boolean operations.

principles.name: Frame Synced Spiral Spawn
principles.core_mechanic: Spawn angle and radius derived directly from frame count.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Birth coordinates are purely a function of time - deterministic spiral with no randomness in positioning.
principles.the_twist: Radius expands modulo 360 creating infinite outward spiral that loops but never repeats exactly.

principles.name: Deterministic Frame Random
principles.core_mechanic: Seed random number generator with frame number to get reproducible chaos.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Randomness changes frame-to-frame but is reproducible within a frame - same seed always gives same 'random' values.
principles.the_twist: Allows deterministic glitch effects where things look random but follow a predictable cycle.

principles.name: Stepped Lifetime Alpha
principles.core_mechanic: Non-linear alpha mapping - full opacity for first half of life, then steep drop-off.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Most fading uses linear or smoothstep - this creates a binary-then-linear curve that feels more decisive.
principles.the_twist: The sudden transition from fully opaque to fading creates a 'pop' effect that draws attention.

principles.name: Blend Mode Mood Mapping
principles.sketch: Ripple on ripple / Draw line when you get close
principles.core_mechanic: Blend mode selection (ADD vs SUBTRACT) as primary aesthetic decision.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Most artists treat blend mode as a secondary setting - Kiyoshi uses it as the main emotional signal.
principles.the_twist: ADD = ethereal/ghostly, SUBTRACT = aggressive/cutting - the blend mode IS the mood.

principles.name: Voxel Grid Threshold
principles.core_mechanic: 3D grid where noise value determines if a voxel is rendered.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Instead of placing voxels by hand or with physics, noise creates the structure - emergent architecture.
principles.the_twist: Threshold creates sharp edges in otherwise smooth noise, making architectural forms appear.
variations: Different voxel sizes per threshold band

principles.name: Trail History Buffer
principles.core_mechanic: Ring buffer of previous positions to create motion trails.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Instead of simple motion blur, discrete historical positions create segmented trails.
principles.the_twist: Each segment can have different properties (size, color, alpha) creating gradient trails.
variations: Trails that persist after particle dies

principles.name: Wireframe Overlay Blend
principles.core_mechanic: Triangle edge overlay on solid geometry.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Technical drawing aesthetic combined with organic forms - blueprint meets biology.
principles.the_twist: Wireframe uses different blend mode than solid, creating layered depth.
variations: Different wire colors per face group

principles.name: FFMPEG Capture Pipeline
principles.core_mechanic: Capture frames and encode to video using FFMPEG.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: The capture process itself becomes part of the workflow - frame-perfect recording.
principles.the_twist: Using named pipes or raw frame dumping for lossless capture before compression.
variations: Capture at higher res than display

principles.name: Drop Ring Gravity
principles.core_mechanic: Rings fall under gravity and stack/collide with each other.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Simple rigid body stacking but with rings (hollow objects) creates unexpected wobble and roll behaviors.
principles.the_twist: Rings can tilt and roll off each other rather than just stacking flat - emergent physics.
variations: Rings that shatter on hard impact

principles.name: Generative Heart
principles.core_mechanic: Parametric heart shape generation.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Uses parametric equations to create organic heart shapes rather than loaded models.
principles.the_twist: Multiple overlapping hearts with slight parameter variations create moire patterns.
variations: Hearts that morph into other shapes

principles.name: Tunnel Perspective
principles.core_mechanic: Z-depth sprite scaling to create tunnel effect.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Simple 2D sprites with perspective divide create convincing 3D tunnel without actual 3D geometry.
principles.the_twist: Objects at center appear closer, edge objects farther - inverse of normal perspective.

principles.name: Swell Deformation
principles.core_mechanic: Inflate mesh over time using sine-based displacement.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Organic breathing-like motion applied to any geometry - makes rigid objects feel alive.
principles.the_twist: Displacement follows surface normal but amplitude varies by vertex noise value.

principles.name: Two Frame Animation
principles.core_mechanic: Flip between two states to create strobe-like animation.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Only 2 frames - no in-between - creating harsh digital aesthetic.
principles.the_twist: The two frames can be completely different (not just A/B of same motion).

principles.name: Generative Text
principles.core_mechanic: Text as generative geometry source.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Letters aren't rendered as text but converted to geometry that can be manipulated.
principles.the_twist: Text outlines become particle emitters or mesh boundaries.

principles.name: Rampaging Torus Knot
principles.core_mechanic: Chaotic parameters on torus knot creating unstable forms.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Torus knot parameters (p, q) animated with noise instead of fixed - topology becomes fluid.
principles.the_twist: The knot can self-intersect and unravel in ways physical string couldn't.

principles.name: Alternate Torus Flip
principles.core_mechanic: Inside-out surface rendering of torus.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Flips face normals so you see the 'inside' of the surface - impossible in physical reality.
principles.the_twist: Can alternate which faces point outward based on noise or position, creating patchwork surfaces.

principles.name: Hexagonal Tile Morph
principles.core_mechanic: Hexagonal grid with deformation.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Regular hex grid combined with organic displacement creates crystal-meets-nature aesthetic.
principles.the_twist: Individual hexes can rotate, scale, and translate independently while maintaining grid adjacency.

principles.name: Circle Packing Growth
principles.core_mechanic: Circles grow from seeds until they touch another circle.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Simple collision-based growth creates organic packing patterns similar to cells or bubbles.
principles.the_twist: New seeds spawn in gaps between existing circles, filling space optimally.

principles.name: Mosaic Reconstruction
principles.core_mechanic: Tiles assemble from scattered positions to form an image.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Reverse destruction - pieces come together rather than falling apart.
principles.the_twist: Each tile takes a unique path to its destination, creating choreographed assembly.

principles.name: Arrow Field Flow
principles.core_mechanic: Grid of arrows that rotate to point toward a target.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Simple directional indicators create emergent flow field visualization.
principles.the_twist: Arrows can point toward multiple targets with weighted influence, creating interference patterns.

principles.name: Ribbon Twist Deformation
principles.core_mechanic: Twist a flat ribbon along its path.
principles.what_makes_it_weird: Simple 2D ribbon becomes 3D through progressive rotation along its length.
principles.the_twist: Twist amount can vary along the ribbon, creating sections of flat and twisted.
